lines.text: Did you get a 10 percent raise this year? Bad news: you might actually be poorer.
Let me explain the invisible tax stealing your wealth: real inflation.
Official inflation might be 5 percent. But education? 10 percent. Healthcare? 12 percent. Real estate? 15 percent.
If your salary grows at 8 percent, your purchasing power is actually shrinking.
This is why saving in a bank account isn't enough. You have to invest in assets that outpace your real inflation rate. Subscribe to learn how money actually works.
